displayAddress: Foundry Yard at Alexandra Gate, Brook Road, London, N8
description:
Welcome to Foundry Yard by Berkeley Living, a community of brand-new apartments to rent set within Alexandra Gate, Wood Green, offering stylish homes, enviable amenities, and seamless support from our on-site team. 

With prices starting from £2350 per month, our one-bedroom apartments offer a range of layouts and sizes, with all benefitting from open-plan kitchens with integrated appliances, built-in wardrobes in all bedrooms, and keyless entry. Generous living areas make these apartments flexible for sharers, couples, families or those looking for some extra space for a work-from-home office.

At Foundry Yard, life is designed around you, giving you more than just an apartment - you get spa-style amenities with home comforts. Brand new apartments with practical layouts and thoughtful design are complemented by amazing amenities that encourage you to live beyond your four walls. Take a swim in the on-site pool, unwind in the sauna or steam room, take in the views from our roof terraces, get focused in the co-working spaces, or meet your neighbours and enjoy life in the community.   

Life Made Simple
Move through your day with support from the Berkeley Living team whenever you need it, making everyday life seamless. It's renting that fits your pace - effortless, practical, and it will feel like home from day one. 

Location
Nestled within the thriving Alexandra Gate community, Foundry Yard offers the perfect balance of city convenience and access to wonderful green spaces. The location offers plenty to enjoy locally - from Alexandra Palace and its 196-acre park to a wide range of shops, cafés, and restaurants nearby. It's a neighbourhood where everything you need is within reach, while still keeping you connected to the rest of London. 

Residents benefit from four nearby stations - Hornsey, Turnpike Lane, Alexandra Palace and Wood Green - you can reach key London destinations such as King's Cross St Pancras, Covent Garden and the City in 30 minutes or less, making commuting, working, or exploring London simple and convenient. 

Find where you belong and experience Foundry Yard for yourself - arrange a viewing today and discover how effortless renting can be.
